points.why: Identifies the rich-get-richer loop in which the routing rule amplifies an early edge, which is Success to the Successful in substance.
Explains that more leads let the favored rep cherry-pick warm ones while the other must chase cold leads, so close rate reflects allocation.
Recommends random or round-robin shares, capped swings and like-for-like comparison before any PIP decision.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly says the gap may be illusory and could come from early noise alone.
Does not frame it as Escalation or as reps reacting to each other.
